body:
> What this will do is keep displaying the last results when people will use backspace to delete their search term

Yes indeed.

> I feel that what is needed for the linked use case is more a way of disabling the initial search() on the instantsearch instanciation.

The need is not just on first query, if you erase things like on jadopado.com then they still display the nice homepage (= no empty query).

So if we have `searchOnInit: false` we will still be able to do what we want (given we have events like #184) but we will do empty queries for nothing (and then hide the result).
